_comment: T-06 · A_len channel validation — 20-run targeted matrix
_purpose: Validate A_len (episode-length degradation channel) as secondary failure criterion immune to healthy_reward masking. Scope: M1+M3 × {abrupt, baseline} × 5 seeds = 20 runs. Uses same checkpoints as T-05. Requires patched audit_deploy.py (computes mean_ep_len_k from full in-memory ep_starts before the [:50] save truncation).
_why_not_retroactive: T-05 metrics files save only episode_starts[:50], covering steps 0-49000. All evaluation windows (ws >= K0*S = 100000) have zero episode starts → mean_ep_len_k is NaN → T_len=None always. New runs required.
_scope: M1 (no masking condition — T_soft blind) + M3 (noisy condition — partial masking). abrupt (sharp signal) + baseline (FAR check). Gradual omitted — A_len signal at gradual onset is secondary concern; abrupt is the hard case.
_hard_failure_counts_rationale: Hopper falls are recoverable episode resets; only T_soft and T_len drive T_comp.
